question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the highlighted idiom**

The actress’ daughter is just a **__chip off the old block__.**

options.text: Similar to one’s parents in behaviour

solution:
The correct answer is: **Similar to one’s parents in behaviour.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom **'Chip off the old block'** is an expression used for someone whose character or personality resembles that of their parent.

 
 
• **Example- ***He is a real **chip off the old block**. When I looked at his father, I saw that they were similar.*
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom **'Chip off the old block'** is **'Similar to one’s parents in behaviour.**'
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **option 2**.
